status.implementationGate: Every descriptor gameplayImplemented is false. Root combat implementation and actual approved-art registry must independently gate play.

api.fallback: Frozen 69 primary IDs plus blue-executor; other two historical conditional IDs stay excluded.

sourcePolicy.sourceExplicit: Only words/actions present in the supplied prose. Empty means no individual source attack is asserted.
sourcePolicy.sceneContext: Joint or environmental action must not be presented as an individually named attack.
sourcePolicy.gameplayAdaptation: All pattern shapes, emission counts, speeds, damage geometry and windup/active/recovery ticks are proposed vertical gameplay contracts, not prose facts or coded mechanics.
sourcePolicy.stageCounts: Only six defense waves, six rings, three Siren phases and three causal stages use canonical-explicit-count. Other stage counts are authored implementation beats.

correctedOutcomeBoundaries.note: Balrog chest hit and summoning-circle break precede the vortex/memory-collapse fall. Do not force player death in the Balrog fight.
The computation core collapses and the chairman vanishes before the return signal is lost; this is not a bodily fall.
Temporary sealing and castle failure are a canonical transition, not the protagonist dying or falling.
Body defeat, black-neural revival, living Samong awakening and authority duel stay in one encounter. Preserve core and distinct worlds.
